title: Shipping times and carriers
content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the US. International orders ship with tracked delivery in 5 to 8 business days.
body_md: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the US. International orders ship with tracked delivery in 5 to 8 business days.

title: Refund and return policy
content: Items can be returned within 30 days in original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.
body_md: Items can be returned within 30 days in original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.

title: Resetting two-factor authentication
content: Open Settings, choose Security, then select Reset two-factor to scan a new QR code.
body_md: Open Settings, choose Security, then select Reset two-factor to scan a new QR code.

title: Changing your account email
content: Go to Profile and edit the email field. A confirmation link is sent to the new address.
